fact: The Ministry of Education's EMIS and ICT Executive Office released the Education Statistics Annual Abstract 2022/2023 (2015 E.C.), dated October 2023, covering general education from records collected by EMIS; the foreword text names the 2021/22 year, but the cover says 2022/23.

The Ethiopian Statistics Service released the 2015 E.C. Statistical Abstract in print and on its website, and its Director General said administrative records are one source for the figures, compiled from various institutions.

The Ethiopian Statistics Service ran a three-day training in Semera for Afar regional sector offices on collecting, managing and analysing administrative records so they can be used as official statistics.
